factories.name: new_search_tickets_step
factories.description: Search tickets by status, requester email, tag, update time, and keywords, returning one bounded page and a cursor for the next.

inputSchema.description: SearchTicketsInput selects tickets with typed filters that the connector turns into one Zendesk search query. Different filters narrow each other; several statuses or several tags match any of them. At least one filter is required.

cursor.description: Cursor is a previous page's NextCursor. Zendesk expires it one hour after that page was returned.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to MaxSearchPageSize tickets; zero uses DefaultSearchPageSize.

requesterEmail.description: RequesterEmail matches tickets whose requester has this email address, such as jane@example.com.

statuses.description: Statuses matches tickets in any of these Zendesk statuses. Empty matches every status.

tags.description: Tags matches tickets carrying any of these lowercase tags.

text.description: Text holds up to 32 plain keywords that must all appear in the ticket's subject, description, or comments. Search operators such as : < > = " * and a leading - or + are rejected, so the text cannot change the other filters. Blank matches any text.

updatedSince.description: UpdatedSince matches tickets updated at or after this RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset, such as 2026-01-21T00:00:00Z. Blank applies no time filter.

factories.name: new_get_ticket_step
factories.description: Read one ticket by ID with its requester and a bounded list of its latest comments.

inputSchema.description: GetTicketInput names one ticket and how many of its latest comments to return.

latestCommentLimit.description: LatestCommentLimit is 1 to MaxLatestCommentLimit; zero uses DefaultLatestCommentLimit.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Zendesk ticket ID.

factories.name: new_create_ticket_step
factories.description: Create one ticket with its first comment under a Zendesk Idempotency-Key derived from the Step, so a retried or re-dispatched Step returns the same ticket.

TicketCommentInput.description: TicketCommentInput is one comment to add to a ticket.

body.description: Body is the plain-text comment. It is required and is sent as Zendesk's body, so HTML is not rendered.

isInternalNote.description: IsInternalNote adds the comment as an internal note that only agents can see; false adds a public reply that Zendesk may email to the requester.

TicketRequesterInput.description: TicketRequesterInput identifies the requester by email. Zendesk uses an existing user with that address or, when the account allows it, creates one named Name.

email.description: Email is one bare address such as jane@example.com.

name.description: Name is used only when Zendesk creates a new user; blank lets Zendesk derive one.

inputSchema.description: CreateTicketInput is one new ticket and its first comment. Zero IDs and empty enums leave the field to Zendesk's defaults and the account's triggers.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns the ticket to an agent, or zero for none.

brandId.description: BrandID places the ticket in a brand, or zero for the account's default brand.

comment.description: Comment is the first comment, which also becomes the ticket description.

externalId.description: ExternalID stores an application correlation ID; Zendesk does not enforce uniqueness.

groupId.description: GroupID assigns the ticket to a group, or zero for none.

priority.description: Priority is a Zendesk priority, or empty for none.

requester.description: Requester is the customer asking for help. Nil makes the connection's agent the requester.

subject.description: Subject is the ticket subject. It is required.

tags.description: Tags are lowercase tags set on the new ticket; account triggers may add more.

type.description: Type is a Zendesk ticket type, or empty for none.

factories.name: new_update_ticket_step
factories.description: Change the status, priority, assignee, group, or tags of one ticket and optionally add one public reply or internal note, applied at most once per Step.

TicketCommentInput.description: TicketCommentInput is one comment to add to a ticket.

body.description: Body is the plain-text comment. It is required and is sent as Zendesk's body, so HTML is not rendered.

isInternalNote.description: IsInternalNote adds the comment as an internal note that only agents can see; false adds a public reply that Zendesk may email to the requester.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTicketInput is one change to an existing ticket. Empty and zero fields are left unchanged; this release cannot clear an assignee or group.

addTags.description: AddTags adds lowercase tags and keeps the ticket's other tags.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns an agent, or zero to keep the assignee.

comment.description: Comment adds one public reply or internal note, or nil for none.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: ExpectedUpdatedAt is the ticket's UpdatedAt as the application last read it, an RFC 3339 instant such as 2026-01-28T08:45:00Z. A later change selects conflict; blank writes regardless.

groupId.description: GroupID assigns a group, or zero to keep the group.

priority.description: Priority is the new Zendesk priority, or empty to keep it.

removeTags.description: RemoveTags removes lowercase tags and keeps the ticket's other tags.

status.description: Status is the new Zendesk status, or empty to keep it.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Zendesk ticket ID.
